name: juris-scraper
description: Multi-site judicial scraping engine. First site: PJe Consulta Publica of Brazil's TRF5.

dependencyNotes.policy: Runtime dependencies are fixed by the architecture and pinned to an exact version. Any addition must be pure JavaScript and justified here.
dependencyNotes.@aws-sdk/client-s3: S3 API client. One interface reaches RustFS, AWS S3, GCS (HMAC interop) and Garage.
dependencyNotes.@electric-sql/pglite: Postgres compiled to WASM. Same DDL and queries as the Docker Postgres, with no native build step, so the no-Docker path is a real Postgres.
dependencyNotes.cheerio: HTML parsing. No JavaScript from the site is ever executed.
dependencyNotes.pg: Postgres driver for the default path.
dependencyNotes.tough-cookie: RFC 6265 cookie jar. The site pins a cluster node through cookie path scoping.
dependencyNotes.@eslint/js: Dev only: the recommended rule set that eslint.config.js extends. Ships from the eslint project itself.
